records.title: Docs: canonical report text sharing outputs
records.body:
Documents the non-blocking architecture for adding Share as Text and Copy Text alongside existing PDF output.

Key constraints:
- one canonical report data source
- independent PDF/Text renderers
- PDF typography remains Vazirmatn UI FD
- no parallel settings/report architecture
- fully parallel with current production flow
- no pause/cancel/restart of active workflows or PRs

This PR is documentation-only and intentionally isolated from the main production implementation lane.

records.title: feat(report): add canonical plain-text renderer
records.body:
Refs #503 and architecture PR #502.

Adds a pure `TaskReportTextRenderer` over the existing canonical `TaskReport` projection so the same report data can feed PDF/Print and plain-text output without a second reporting model.

Scope:
- deterministic Persian plain-text output
- title + generated date
- status, description, reminder, tags, checklist and follow-ups
- explicit empty-report output
- focused regression tests

Safety / Maximum Parallel:
- exactly two new files
- no existing product file modified
- no Task/report model or persistence change
- no PDF renderer change
- no pubspec/dependency change
- no UI/share-plugin wiring yet
- does not pause/cancel/restart any active lane, workflow, PR, Build, Device Smoke or Production Orchestrator

Keep Draft until exact-head Fast/CI is green. UI `Copy text` / native text-share wiring should be a separate small lane after this pure foundation validates.
